# Aveneg Technologies, LLC

> Software publisher building private, offline software for people who keep a careful record of something valuable. It publishes two products: Watch Vault Archive, an encrypted, offline desktop application for cataloguing a watch collection, and Watch Vault Tracker, an iPhone app in development that records the watches a collector wears and is free for watch collectors. Records stay on the owner's own computer or phone: no cloud, no account. This site is the company's corporate site; each product has its own site. Contact is by email only; there is no contact form and no phone number.

- Address: 8735 Dunwoody Place, Ste R, Atlanta, GA 30350, United States
- Commercial licensing and legal: legal@avenegtechnologies.com
- General inquiries: info@avenegtechnologies.com

## Products

- [Watch Vault Archive](https://watchvaultarchive.com): the company's encrypted, offline watch-collection application, on its own site
- [Watch Vault Archive Terms of Service](https://watchvaultarchive.com/terms): the terms that govern the application
- [Watch Vault Archive Privacy Policy](https://watchvaultarchive.com/privacy): how the application handles data
- [Watch Vault Tracker](https://watchvaulttracker.com): an iPhone app, in development and coming Winter 2027, that records the watches a collector wears; free for watch collectors, on its own site
- [Watch Vault Tracker Terms of Service](https://watchvaulttracker.com/terms): the terms published for the Tracker's website; the app's own terms are promised before release
- [Watch Vault Tracker Privacy Policy](https://watchvaulttracker.com/privacy): how the Tracker's website and app handle data
